recordedFrom: c8434f62, before the TypeScript moves: reach maps each exported interface to the other exported types that took the key a consumer adds to the interface by module augmentation (declare module '@muxui/react' { interface I { key?: 'key' } }), read under TypeScript 6.0.3 (node test/support/declaration-surface.mjs --reach <generated directory>). A type is reached when it declares the key itself: a string index signature alone is not a reach. An entry T means every arm of T declares the key, and T/A means arm A of the union T does and its other arms do not. An interface that reached no other type is not listed
